Image Description: The image depicts a modern, clean bathroom with a minimalist design. On the left side, there is a white bathtub with a chrome showerhead and a curved shower rod above it, which supports a transparent shower curtain (not visible in the image). The wall behind the tub is covered in small, white rectangular tiles arranged vertically, creating a sleek and uniform look. A circular chrome control knob for the water temperature and flow is mounted on the wall near the tub.
